title: Rapid enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay technique by ultrasound waves in a sonicator bath
protocol: Activate the polystyrene surface by coating with FNAB.
Photoactivate the coated wells using UV light for 15 minutes at a wavelength of 365 nm.
Immobilize capture molecules onto activated and untreated polystyrene microtiter plates using ultrasound waves in a sonicator bath.
Block the immobilized capture molecule-coated wells.
Add human IgG or human IgE analyte to the blocked wells.
Incubate the plates with secondary antibody-conjugate.
Wash the plates after each step.
Develop color by adding 100 µl of substrate-dye buffer to each well.
Stop the reaction by adding 20 µl of 5% sulfuric acid.
